architecture_comparison.benchmark_protocol: Apples-to-apples evaluation across all 5 tasks on identical post_id-grouped 65/15/20 splits of 459 curated real Reddit comments (200 distinct threads, seed=20261116, 0 synthetic rows). Auxiliary 54-probe stress scores are observational only.

why_transformer.selected_architecture: MuRIL-DAPT v3 Transformer (+ validation-calibrated Word+Char TF-IDF Hybrid, alpha >= 0.50)

key_reasons.title: Real unseen-thread Reddit benchmark (0 synthetic data)
key_reasons.evidence: Trained and tested strictly on 459 curated real Reddit comments across 200 distinct threads (post_id-grouped 65/15/20): MuRIL-DAPT v3 achieves 59.6% mean held-out real test Macro F1 (Hybrid 59.5%) vs. LogReg 47.5%, ANN 43.5%, CNN 42.3%.

key_reasons.title: Auxiliary 54-probe stress diagnostic (never used for selection)
key_reasons.evidence: On the untouched 54-probe stress diagnostic across slang, paraphrases, typos, and Hinglish, MuRIL-DAPT v3 retains 51.5% mean Macro F1 (Hybrid 51.1%) compared to LogReg 34.5%, ANN 43.2%, and CNN 25.3%.

key_reasons.title: Held-out validated DAPT MLM domain adaptation
key_reasons.evidence: Masked Language Modeling on 2,780 unlabeled real Reddit texts reduced held-out validation perplexity from 94.347 -> 20.123 on 379 disjoint unseen texts.

key_reasons.title: Non-sharpening calibration (T >= 1.0) & static serving
key_reasons.evidence: Validation temperature scaling strictly clamped to T >= 1.0 yields honest probability bounds (mean held-out ECE 0.065), and precomputed artifacts serve Vercel/Docker in <10 ms with zero runtime GPU cost.
